_note: Two layers. (1) Index: each stage lists the broad syllabus area(s) it sits in (covers_syllabus_refs / syllabus_topic, as the source spec names them). (2) Coverage: _syllabus_items is the specification broken into its own atomic items, and each stage lists the item ids it teaches in covers_items, so coverage_check.py can say whether the WHOLE specification is taught. Top-level keys starting with _ are metadata, never stages.

_meta.semantics: covers_syllabus_refs is an index of the areas a stage is principally associated with; it does not claim exhaustive coverage of those areas, exam weighting, or official stage boundaries. Coverage is claimed only through _syllabus_items + covers_items, and only as far as coverage_check.py confirms (declared coverage, not verified teaching).

_items_source.document: University of London LLM module short-course pages confirming the real four-sub-module (A-D) structure of each of the four chosen modules, combined with the standard postgraduate commercial-law topic breakdown for each subject (Advanced Contract Law, Industrial and Intellectual Property, International Trade Law, EU Competition Law) as taught in any Master's-level module on that subject. UoL's own internal subject-guide unit numbering below sub-module level sits behind the VLE and could not be resolved, so this course invents its own stable id scheme built on UoL's confirmed, open sub-module letters (e.g. LWM83-A1 for the first item within Advanced Contract Law's sub-module A), recorded honestly here rather than reproducing gated numbering.
_items_source.version: Standard-topic itemisation compiled 2026-09-22 against UoL's confirmed sub-module (A-D) structure for each chosen module; UoL's internal below-sub-module numbering not accessible.
